name: jev-steer-or-queue
description: Use TypeSafe Jev to decide whether a message sent mid-turn should steer the running task, wait in a queue, or stop it.

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: Key for api.typesafe.ai. Leave empty to use the TYPESAFE_API_KEY environment variable.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: shadow: only log Jev's decisions. active: queue and stop messages for real.
